lines: The first jump takes a sock. The second takes your left slipper. The third takes your *shadow*.
The fifth takes a word. You open your mouth to talk to your sister... and you can't remember her name.
Kit holds up a photo and says: it's Kit. It's *Kit*. She is not laughing anymore.
And you can't help but wonder... what did your very *last* jump take?
Follow and comment... for part three!
